name: Applications
tagline: Sort job descriptions against your CV, or CVs against a role.
decisionQuestion: Is this role a strong fit for my CV?

criteriaTemplate.label: Seniority
criteriaTemplate.value: Graduate or up to two years of experience. Exclude senior and lead roles.

criteriaTemplate.label: Must have
criteriaTemplate.value: Python or TypeScript named in the requirements.

criteriaTemplate.label: Location
criteriaTemplate.value: UK based, remote or hybrid acceptable.

criteriaTemplate.label: Sponsorship
criteriaTemplate.value: Exclude roles that state no visa sponsorship.

extractionFields.label: Gaps
extractionFields.hint: Named requirements the CV does not evidence

extractionFields.label: Keywords to mirror
extractionFields.hint: Exact phrases worth echoing in the application
